name: RoyaleCoach
title: Software Developer & Computer Science Student
tagline: Informatics Engineering student who believes in writing clean, maintainable code.
shortBio: Software Developer & Computer Science student passionate about software engineering, AI integration, cryptography, and building things that work.
bio: I'm an undergraduate student majoring in Informatics Engineering at Institut Teknologi Sepuluh Nopember (ITS), under the Faculty of Intelligent Electrical and Informatics Technology (FTEIC). I've been writing code for a few years now, and I still find it fascinating how a few lines can turn an idea into something real.

My interests live at the intersection of software engineering, AI integration, cybersecurity, and system design. I'm a daily Linux user — not because it's trendy, but because understanding how things work under the hood makes me a better developer.

Outside of university coursework, I spend most of my time building personal projects, reading documentation, and learning from open-source codebases. I believe the best way to grow as an engineer is to keep building, keep breaking things, and keep learning from both.
story: It started during the pandemic. Stuck at home with a laptop and too much time, I stumbled into C# and never looked back. There was something magical about typing words and seeing a program come to life.

What kept me going wasn't the syntax — it was the problem-solving. The feeling of staring at a bug for hours, then finally cracking it. The satisfaction of building something from nothing and watching it work.

Today, I code because it's how I think. Every project is a puzzle, every architecture decision is a tradeoff, and every line of code is a choice. I'm not just writing software — I'm crafting solutions.

goals.description: Master Rust and systems programming. Build production-grade open source tools. Land a software engineering internship.
Contribute to major open source projects. Build AI-powered developer tools. Graduate with strong fundamentals.
Become a software architect who bridges the gap between research and production. Build tools that empower other developers.
